list.title: Portfolio
list.description: My personal portfolio, where I aggregate my projects and skills.

list.title: One Pace BR Hub
list.description: Hub focused on gathering the edited episodes and Brazilian Portuguese (PT-BR) subtitles for the One Pace project.

resources.title: Domain-driven route architecture (Home/Saga/Arc)
resources.description: Navigation was organized by context to be intuitive: the Home provides a catalog overview, the Saga page groups related arcs, and the Arc page deep dives into each block's details. This separation clarifies the user flow and facilitates project evolution without creating coupling between screens.

resources.title: Dynamic SEO with full metadata per page
resources.description: Each screen automatically updates title, description, canonical, Open Graph, Twitter Card, and JSON-LD. Consequently, shared links are more attractive, search engines understand the content better, and each route gains its own identity instead of inheriting generic metadata.

resources.title: Scraping layer with fallback for blocking scenarios
resources.description: When an external source limits requests or partially fails, the system attempts alternative paths (RSS, HTML, or direct link) to retrieve data. This reduces the chance of broken screens and improves experience reliability, especially in torrent search flows.

resources.title: Automated scraping cache via workflow
resources.description: An automated routine updates the link cache at scheduled intervals. In practice, this decreases real-time scraping costs, improves user response time, and keeps important data ready for use even when the provider is unstable.

resources.title: qBittorrent WebUI integration
resources.description: Users can send bulk links directly to a configured qBittorrent client, removing the need to manually copy and paste item by item. The flow includes URL validation, authentication, session handling, and clear success or error messages for easier diagnostics.

resources.title: Smart extraction and prioritization of torrent links
resources.description: The system identifies magnet links and hashes, removes duplicates, and prioritizes the most useful versions based on criteria like quality and availability. This reduces noise in the final list and increases the chance of the user downloading the correct option on the first try.

resources.title: Locally persisted display preferences
resources.description: Settings such as theme, sorting order, visual filters, and hiding completed sagas are saved in the browser. Thus, when the person returns to the site, the interface already appears in their preferred format without needing to reconfigure everything on each visit.

resources.title: Centralized settings in a side panel
resources.description: Product options were gathered into a single panel with clear sections like display, torrent provider, feedback, and useful links. This avoids scattered navigation across multiple screens and makes feature discovery simpler for new users.

resources.title: Internationalization support (i18n)
resources.description: The base is already prepared for multiple languages with an integrated translation structure. Even with a primary focus on PT-BR, this paves the way for future expansion without structural rework and helps maintain consistent copy across the entire interface.

resources.title: Specialized Brazilian hub for One Pace
resources.description: The product acts as a single reference point for the BR community to track One Pace content with better organization. Instead of relying on scattered sources, users find the paths to discover, understand, and continue their journey in one place.

resources.title: Discovery and continuity-oriented experience
resources.description: The proposal is not just to list content, but to guide the user between sagas and arcs logically, helping them decide the next step. This improves both the onboarding for beginners and the continuity for long-time followers.

resources.title: Community-driven, iterative, and open to contributions
resources.description: The hub's evolution is designed with community participation through feedback and issues. This model makes the product more alive, with improvements aligned to real usage needs, and strengthens the collaborative nature of the initiative.

list.title: Treine-Se
list.description: Fitness application built in React using Capacitor's web bridge to port to mobile.

resources.title: Custom manual workout creation
resources.description: A two-step flow that allows you to build a workout from scratch with more control: you choose the exercises, define sets, reps, weight, and rest, and save everything into an organized routine for future use.

resources.title: AI-powered workout generation
resources.description: The app conducts a simple questionnaire about goals, fitness level, and preferences, and the AI builds a personalized routine including exercise justifications. Afterward, the user can review, adjust, and save it.

resources.title: Guided workout execution (play mode)
resources.description: During the workout, the experience focuses on execution: active timer, progression between exercises, set completion control, and finishing with historical tracking for progress monitoring.

resources.title: Progress dashboard
resources.description: The main screen brings together the most useful daily indicators, such as the current workout, completed sessions, weekly streak, and recent activity, helping to maintain consistency and a view of evolution.

resources.title: Customizable profile and preferences
resources.description: Settings allow you to input physical data and usage preferences in simple or advanced modes to better adapt recommendations, visual experience, and general app behavior.

resources.title: Structured local exercise catalog
resources.description: The exercise database is organized in JSON with complete information (type, difficulty, muscles, equipment, and instructions), serving as a source for manual creation and AI suggestions.

resources.title: Search, filters, and assisted selection
resources.description: Workout building features filters by type and difficulty, a search field to quickly locate exercises, and form validations to prevent incomplete or inconsistent routines.

resources.title: Exercise detailing with contextual support
resources.description: Each exercise has a rich view with execution guidance, muscles worked, and required equipment, plus a shortcut to clear doubts with AI directly within the context of the current task.

resources.title: YouTube video demonstration
resources.description: The system searches for videos by query, renders them with an integrated player, and uses caching to speed up loading. It also handles loading and error states to keep the experience stable.

resources.title: Local persistence and external integrations
resources.description: Important data such as profile, workouts, and chat are persisted locally, with integration to external services for authentication, AI, and native mobile features, including local notifications.

list.title: Adedonha
list.description: Adedonha is a digital version of the classic game "Stop/Adedonha," focusing on quick matches between friends. The project aims to maintain the traditional dynamics of paper and pen, but with the support of a timer, letter drawing, score control, and match history.

resources.title: Digital 'Adedonha' game for quick matches
resources.description: The product transforms the classic 'Adedonha' (Stop) game into a simple-to-use web experience, focusing on playing directly in the browser, without registration and without backend dependency.

resources.title: Full match flow on a single screen
resources.description: The main experience happens in a single panel: starting the game, configuring the match, generating letters, counting time, recording points, and closing the ranking at the end.

resources.title: Rounds, time, and number of players configuration
resources.description: Before starting, you can adjust the number of rounds, timer duration, and total players, making the match shorter or longer depending on the group.

resources.title: Letter draw with manual exclusion
resources.description: The app draws letters per round and allows blocking unwanted letters, which helps adapt the game to the difficulty level the group wants.

resources.title: Topic suggestions for playing
resources.description: There is a beta topic suggestion feature that uses a broad internal list (animals, cities, professions, etc.) to unblock matches when ideas are lacking.

resources.title: Round-by-round scoring and final leaderboard
resources.description: Each player reports their round points, the system accumulates the score, and at the end shows the match ranking highlighting the top positions.

resources.title: Local match history with details page
resources.description: Results are saved in the browser (localStorage), can be revisited in a paginated history modal, and opened in a detailed view.

resources.title: Download results and game material
resources.description: The product allows downloading the leaderboard image and generating a PDF template for printing, useful for those who want to maintain the physical dynamics of the game.

resources.title: Sharing and quick links
resources.description: There are buttons to share the game on WhatsApp and X/Twitter, plus a shortcut to the author's GitHub profile.

resources.title: Audio support during the round
resources.description: The app can narrate the drawn letter (speech synthesis) and play a sound alert when time runs out, with sound on/off control.

resources.title: Light/dark theme and responsive interface
resources.description: The interface has light/dark mode with local persistence and an adaptable layout for desktop and mobile, using modals and side menus to keep the screen clean.

resources.title: State handling
resources.description: The product covers start, active match, countdown, time's up, game over, and empty history states; there is no robust remote error flow because it doesn't rely on an API.

resources.title: Lean page/route structure
resources.description: There is no traditional multi-page navigation: it's a single-route SPA, with the journey organized by sections and modals instead of separate pages.

resources.title: Basic SEO and metadata
resources.description: The current base has simple metadata in the HTML (title and viewport), without a more complete social SEO strategy (Open Graph/Twitter Cards) at the moment.

resources.title: Point external integrations
resources.description: Integrations are lightweight and utility-focused: WhatsApp/X for sharing and RoboHash for podium avatars; there is no integration with catalog services, episodes, or subtitles.

list.title: Vet Care
list.description: VetCarePro's web front-end, a platform for managing veterinary clinics with a focus on daily operations: patient care, scheduling, registration, staff, finances, and sales.

resources.title: VetCarePro Web
resources.description: Web platform for veterinary clinic management, unifying care, scheduling, staff, sales, and finance into a single workflow.

resources.title: Login, registration, and onboarding
resources.description: Account entry with form validation, keep-session-active option, and a guided tour to help first-time users navigate the system.

resources.title: Clinic management with profile control
resources.description: Allows listing, creating, editing, and removing clinics, enforcing access permissions before entering each unit's internal area.

resources.title: Operational clinic dashboard
resources.description: Dashboard with quick indicators, upcoming appointments, consultation search, and shortcuts for daily actions without navigating multiple screens.

resources.title: Patient registration and tracking
resources.description: Complete flow to register patients, view details, edit data, and track clinical history in an organized view.

resources.title: Veterinary services management
resources.description: Dedicated area to register services, keep the list updated, and view details of each procedure offered by the clinic.

resources.title: Staff and payroll management
resources.description: Team control with staff registration, editing, and removal, plus support for tracking payroll payments.

resources.title: Appointment scheduling and checkout
resources.description: Organizes appointments with creation, editing, and paginated listing, including consultation completion at the end of the service.

resources.title: Products, inventory, and shopping cart
resources.description: Product registration with inventory status, shopping cart with quantity adjustments, and checkout directly through the interface.

resources.title: PIX payment with QR Code
resources.description: Integrated billing flow with PIX QR Code generation to facilitate payments in both sales and financial routines.

resources.title: Financial panel with controls
resources.description: Consolidates metrics like revenue, debts, and receivables, with an option to hide sensitive values and validate staff payments.

resources.title: Subscription plans and pricing page
resources.description: Presentation of plan tiers (Free, Standard, and Enterprise) with feature comparisons to support purchasing decisions.

resources.title: Light/dark theme and visual customization
resources.description: Allows toggling the interface theme and adjusting visual header elements to make daily use more comfortable.

resources.title: Responsive user experience
resources.description: Interface adapted for mobile, tablet, and desktop, with loading states, error messages, and visual feedback on user actions.

experiences.title: Explore my experiences.

experiences-list.description:
DevStore Project: Acted as the lead Front-end developer, being solely responsible for the project's delivery in its final phase. Developed and maintained scalable web applications in React, using Zustand, Redux, and React Query for state management and consuming REST APIs via Axios. My experience includes using TypeScript, Shadcn, Tailwind CSS, Styled Components, and Material UI to create optimized and accessible user interfaces. Actively contributed to quality assurance through automated testing with Vitest.

Vivo Telefônica (currently): Participated in multiple projects focusing on micro-frontends in the Fintech area. Applied clean code principles and used Mística for UI development. I was responsible for ensuring code robustness through a comprehensive suite of tests, including unit tests with Jest, component tests with Cypress, and mutation tests with Stryker.

Compass UOL scholarship program focusing on front-end development and cloud computing fundamentals. During the program, I deepened my knowledge of React, exploring technologies like Redux, React Query, and other essential tools for building modern and scalable applications. The internship culminated in obtaining the AWS Cloud Practitioner certification, consolidating skills in cloud services and AWS best practices.

experiences-list.company: CNPq - National Council for Scientific and Technological Development
experiences-list.description: Research: PIBIC - Vulnerabilities caused by commits. Supervised by Professor Dr. Rodrigo Andrade. The project aims to analyze the relationship between code commits and the introduction of software vulnerabilities. Using data mining techniques and repository analysis, the study seeks to identify patterns and factors that contribute to the occurrence of security flaws, with the goal of providing insights for safer development practices.

Teaching assistant for Introduction to Computing, a course taught by Professor Dr. Ryan Ribeiro de Azevedo. Responsible for helping students with questions related to programming logic, algorithms, and data structures, as well as providing support during practical classes and evaluations.
